title: Sena (UBT) workers protest against Shaina NC for tearing paper with Bal Thackeray’s photo

ai.summary: Sena (UBT) workers protested outside Sena Bhavan in Dadar, demanding an FIR against Shaina NC for tearing a paper with Bal Thackeray's photo.

facts.claim: Hundreds of protesters, including women, gathered outside Sena Bhavan in Dadar, the headquarters of Sena (UBT), and raised slogans demanding an FIR against her.
facts.quote: Hundreds of protesters, including women, gathered outside Sena Bhavan in Dadar, the headquarters of Sena (UBT), and raised slogans demanding an FIR against her.
